name: TTV Super Star
overview: Super Star, also known as TTV Super Star since 2020 (Chinese: 超級巨星紅白藝能大賞 lit. 'Superstars Red and White Talent Awards') is an annual Chinese New Year's Eve television special produced by Taiwanese broadcaster TTV. It is broadcast simultaneously on television and on the OTT platform, nationally and internationally by the TTV network and by some overseas broadcasters (mainly Singapore and Malaysia). Taiwan Mobile was later sponsored the event and carried digital rights for simulcast premiere in Taiwan between 2018 and 2025. The first special premiered on February 13, 2010, the eve of the 2010 Chinese New Year, and has span a total of 14 competitions since.
